title: Nonnegativity of translated positions
statement: For every nonnegative integer $p$, every side $s$, and every move direction $d\in\{-1,0,+1\}$, translating $d$ using side $s$ and the flag indicating whether $p=0$ gives a physical displacement whose addition to $p$ is nonnegative.
replaced:
Let $p$ be a nonnegative integer, $s$ a side, and $d \in \{-1,0,+1\}$ a move
direction.  Then $p$ plus the physical displacement of the translated move computed
from $s$, the flag ``$p = 0$'', and $d$ is still nonnegative.
